subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: YouTube: Everyone Gets a Camera
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on YouTube: Everyone Gets a Camera.

hook.text: YouTube launched in 2005 so three friends could share party videos. It became TV's rival.

buildup.text: Anyone with a phone can upload a video that millions might see — no studio or network needed.

discovery.text: YouTube creators now earn more than many Hollywood actors through the Partner Program.

twist.text: YouTube is the second-largest search engine in the world, after Google itself.

climax.text: YouTube democratized video creation and turned ordinary people into media companies.

punchline.text: Everyone became a broadcaster with a phone.

quiz.question: What is YouTube's ranking as a search engine?
options: Not a search engine at all
